permissions.page: to show the page you write your prompt on, over the agent's pane or beside the panes

permissions.window.overlay: to keep the page over the pane you work in, and to draw its button in the pane's corner

permissions.ai.ask: to ask Claude to correct the prompt you wrote, with your own Anthropic key; you see each question first

permissions.input.actions: to add a Polish button to the box where you write to your agent, and to correct what you wrote there when you click it; the corrected prompt goes back in the box for you to send

permissions.agent.ask: to put the corrected prompt on Tilefold's ask card for your agent, where you send it, and, if you choose, to ask that agent to check your prompt when you have no Anthropic key
